# Game setup
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 640, 480
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption('Eagle Town')

# Game clock
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Game variables
player = pygame.Rect(320, 240, 32, 32)
player_color = (255, 165, 0)

# Game loop
running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False
    
    # Move player
    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= 5
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += 5
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= 5
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += 5
    
    # Keep player in bounds
    player.x = max(0, min(WIDTH - player.width, player.x))
    player.y = max(0, min(HEIGHT - player.height, player.y))
    
    # Draw
    screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, player_color, player)
    
    # Update display
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
four_args.new_text:
import pygame
pygame.init()

# Game setup
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 640, 480
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption('Eagle Town')

# Game clock
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Game variables
player = pygame.Rect(320, 240, 32, 32)
player_color = (255, 165, 0)

countdown = 60
countdown_timer = 0

countdown_font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 36)

# Game loop
running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False
    
    # Move player
    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= 5
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += 5
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= 5
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += 5
    
    # Keep player in bounds
    player.x = max(0, min(WIDTH - player.width, player.x))
    player.y = max(0, min(HEIGHT - player.height, player.y))
    
    # Update countdown
    countdown_timer += 1
    if countdown_timer >= 60:
        countdown_timer = 0
        countdown -= 1
        if countdown == 0:
            running = False
    
    # Draw
    screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, player_color, player)
    timer_text = countdown_font.render(f"Time: {countdown}", True, (255, 255, 255))
    screen.blit(timer_text, (10, 10))
    
    # Update display
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
